canonical_equations: xp=F*x+u;Pp=F*P*F^T+Q;S=H*Pp*H^T+R;K=Pp*H^T*S^-1;xpost=xp+K*(y-H*xp);Ppost=(I-KH)*Pp*(I-KH)^T+K*R*K^T;guarded Cholesky solves;ordered RN32, mirrored lower triangles.
input_contract: binary32-hex B1..64,n1..6,m1..3;shared F,Q,H,diagonal R>0;per-record x,P,u,y;P,Q exactly symmetric PSD;finite executed intermediates;explicit linear/noise model.
output_contract: B x [u32 status;xp[n],Pp[n*n],xpost[n],Ppost[n*n],innovation[m],chi2];status1 guarded innovation solve rejects with all numeric words zero;status0 success;no covariance calibration guarantee.
result_contract: B x [u32 status;xp[n],Pp[n*n],xpost[n],Ppost[n*n],innovation[m],chi2];status1 guarded innovation solve rejects with all numeric words zero;status0 success;no covariance calibration guarantee.
precision_requirements: Finite IEEE binary32 values, explicitly supplied as eight hex digits (encoding=binary32-hex). Every +,-,*,/,sqrt rounds to nearest ties-to-even; gradual underflow; canonical positive zero after arithmetic. No FMA or reassociation. Nonfinite inputs, intermediate overflow, division by zero and invalid roots reject the job on CPU before dispatch. Bit identity is to this specified rounded algorithm, not exact real arithmetic or other library reduction orders.
validation_method: Full byte comparison against independent exact-rational RN32 CPU oracle; analytic, adversarial and held-out vectors; arithmetic tested separately.
